snippet.title: Plato - play together
snippet.description:
We believe that the best games are the ones that bring people closer together. 

Our mission at Plato is to foster a meaningful social gaming experience by combining games & chatting in the best way possible. 

We also keep all game playing experience pure and fair with no pay-to-win gimmicks.

Play Plato for free on both iOS & Android: 
https://www.platoapp.com/download

Plato is built by the original creators of Yahoo! Games - multiplayer games & community is in our DNA.

Say hello to us on Twitter or Facebook @platochat
